$comment: Domain taxonomy for the technical security certification roadmap. 13 columns across 4 bands. Ordered left-to-right as rendered on the chart.

domains.label: Penetration Testing
domains.blurb: Network and infrastructure assessment; general-purpose offensive certs. Mobile pentest lives here.

domains.label: Web & API Security
domains.blurb: Application-layer offensive work: web, API, and browser-side exploitation.

domains.label: Exploit Dev & Vuln Research
domains.blurb: Binary exploitation, fuzzing, memory corruption, 0-day research.

domains.label: SOC & Detection Engineering
domains.blurb: Alert triage, SIEM, detection authoring, and security monitoring operations.

domains.label: Digital Forensics
domains.blurb: Host, network, mobile, and cloud artifact analysis; evidence handling.

domains.label: Incident Response
domains.blurb: Containment, eradication, recovery, and breach handling.

domains.label: Threat Intel & Hunting
domains.blurb: CTI production, adversary tracking, and hypothesis-driven threat hunting.

domains.label: Malware Analysis & RE
domains.blurb: Static and dynamic malware analysis, unpacking, reverse engineering.

domains.label: Cloud & Container Security
domains.blurb: AWS/Azure/GCP security, Kubernetes, and container runtime hardening. Excludes pure cloud-ops certs.

domains.label: Security Engineering & Arch
domains.blurb: Systems hardening, secure network and identity design, security architecture, and cryptography engineering.

domains.label: Secure Dev & DevSecOps
domains.blurb: Secure SDLC, code review, supply chain, and pipeline security.

domains.label: OT / ICS / IoT & Hardware
domains.blurb: Industrial control systems, SCADA, embedded, and hardware security.

domains.label: AI / ML Security
domains.blurb: Securing AI systems, model/prompt attacks, and AI governance with a technical bent.

tiers.label: Entry
tiers.blurb: No experience assumed. Vocabulary and fundamentals.

tiers.label: Associate
tiers.blurb: 0-2 years. Can execute defined tasks under supervision.

tiers.label: Professional
tiers.blurb: 2-5 years. Works independently on real engagements.

tiers.label: Expert
tiers.blurb: 5-10 years. Handles novel problems; often practical multi-day exams.

tiers.label: Master
tiers.blurb: 10+ years. Field-defining difficulty; very low pass rates.
